verdicts.why: پر glossed 'about' but seed renders 'think about'-less 'consider ten possible problems'; the postposition is in LEGO L1 and is a dropped/unrendered word.
اب is in the seed and LEGO 'any more', but the seed renders it as 'any more' not 'now'.
ہے is in the LEGO 'it's very important' and the seed has 'it's'; 'is' is contracted into 'it's'.
ہیں is in LEGO L2 but the seed renders it as 'has', so literal 'are' is a back-gloss.
تھی is in LEGO 'didn't need to' and the seed 'didn't need' renders it in the past-tense auxiliary, not 'was'.
ہے is in the LEGO and the seed has "he's happy"; 'is' is clitic-fused into "he's".
ہے is in LEGO L2 and the seed has "she's worried"; 'is' is clitic-fused into "she's".
بات in LEGO L2 corresponds to the seed's 'discuss'; 'talk' is a different lemma gloss.
میرا in LEGO L2 'what I mean' corresponds to the seed's 'I' in 'I mean'; 'my' is a literal gloss of the possessive.
نہیں is in LEGO L1 and the seed has "wouldn't"; 'not' is clitic-fused into "wouldn't".
چاہوں گا is in LEGO L1 and the seed has "wouldn't like"; "I'd like" is not contiguous because 'I wouldn't' is interposed.
لگانا is part of LEGO 'to guess' (اندازہ لگانا); 'to make' is a literal gloss the seed does not render.
تھا is in LEGO 'I wanted' and the seed has 'wanted'; the past auxiliary 'was' is not rendered.
سے is in LEGO 'غور سے' = 'carefully'; 'from' is a literal gloss the seed does not render.
اس is in LEGO 'اس وقت' = 'at the moment'; 'this' is a literal gloss not rendered in the seed.
میرے is in LEGO 'میرے خیال میں' = 'I think that'; 'my' is a literal gloss the seed does not render.
بہت کم is in the LEGO and the seed has "don't know many"; 'not many' is split by 'know'.
کو is in LEGO 'اپنے بھائی کو' = 'her brother'; 'to' is a literal gloss the seed does not render.
لا is in LEGO L2 and the seed has 'she could if she wanted to'; 'bring' is not rendered in the seed.
جانے کے لیے is in the LEGO and the seed has 'to leave'; 'to go' is a different lemma gloss of the same word.
